contents.en: There are two types of sanctioned Magic tournaments: rated and casual.
contents.zh: 万智牌认证赛事分为两种：积分赛和休闲赛。

contents.en: There are two major tournament formats: Limited and Constructed.
contents.zh: 主要的赛制有两种——限制赛和构组赛。

extras.en:
Limited formats include any format in which a player constructs a deck during the event.

Draft and Sealed Deck are common examples.
extras.zh:
限制赛包括任何需要牌手在比赛过程中构筑套牌的赛制。

轮抽赛和现开赛是常见的例子。

contents.en: Each has rules specific to its format. In Limited tournaments, all product for play is provided during the tournament. In Constructed tournaments, players compete using decks prepared beforehand.
contents.zh: 每个赛制都有自身特有的规则。在限制比赛中，用于进行比赛的所有产品都是在比赛过程中提供。在构组比赛中，牌手使用赛前所准备好的套牌来参赛。

extras.en: Constructed formats include any format in which a player constructs their deck before the event.
extras.zh: 构组赛包括任何需要牌手在比赛前构组套牌的赛制。

contents.en: The Tournament Organizer of a tournament is responsible for all tournament logistics including:
contents.zh: 比赛主办人负责所有的比赛后勤工作，包括：

contents.en: * Sanctioning the event.
contents.zh: * 规划认证赛事。

extras.en: This is obtained by sanctioning the event in EventLink through the creation of the event. Each event has a unique sanctioning number.
extras.zh: 这项认证通过在EventLink中创建比赛即可获得。每场比赛都会有一个唯一的认证号。

contents.en: * Providing a site for the tournament that meets the tournament’s expected needs.
contents.zh: * 为比赛提供满足需求的场所。

extras.en: The organizer must provide enough play space for the expected number of players.
extras.zh: 比赛主办人必须提供一个能够容纳预期牌手数量的场地。

contents.en: * Advertising the tournament in advance of the tournament date.
contents.zh: * 在比赛日前宣传本次比赛。

contents.en: For an 8-player playoff, the 1st place player plays the 8th place player, the 2nd place player plays the 7th place player, the 3rd place player plays the 6th place player, and the 4th place player plays the 5th place player.
contents.zh: 如决胜轮有8位牌手参加，则第1名牌手对上第8名，第2名对上第7名，第3名对上第6名，第4名对上第5名。

contents.en: ![Eight-player playoff bracket by final Swiss standing](data:image/png;base64,)
contents.zh: ![按瑞士轮最终排名排列的八人决胜轮对阵图](data:image/png;base64,)

contents.en: For a 4-player playoff, the 1st place player plays the 4th place player, and the 2nd place player plays the 3rd place player.
contents.zh: 对于有4位牌手参加的决胜轮而言，第1名牌手与第4名牌手对阵，第2名牌手与第3名牌手对阵。

contents.en: ![Four-player playoff bracket](data:image/png;base64,)
contents.zh: ![四人决胜轮对阵图](data:image/png;base64,)

contents.en: Use a random method to seat players around the draft table and conduct the draft.
contents.zh: 使用随机方式将牌手安排在轮抽桌边依次就坐，进行轮抽。

contents.en: ![Eight seats arranged around a Booster Draft table](data:image/png;base64,)
contents.zh: ![补充包轮抽桌周围的八个座位](data:image/png;base64,)

contents.en: After the draft, seat 1 plays seat 5, seat 2 plays seat 6, seat 3 plays seat 7, and seat 4 plays seat 8.
contents.zh: 轮抽结束后，座号1对阵座号5，座号2对阵座号6，座号3对阵座号7，座号4对阵座号8。

contents.en: ![Eight-player playoff bracket by Booster Draft seat](data:image/png;base64,)
contents.zh: ![按补充包轮抽座位排列的八人决胜轮对阵图](data:image/png;base64,)

contents.en: Individual Booster Drafts have the following default time limits for each pick:
contents.zh: 进行个人补充包轮抽时，每一次选牌的默认时间限制如下表所示：

contents.en:
| Cards remaining in pack | Time allotted |
|---|---|
| 15 cards | 40 seconds |
| 10 cards | 25 seconds |
| 5 cards | 10 seconds |
| 1 card | N/A |
contents.zh:
| 补充包剩余牌张数量 | 可使用时间 |
|---|---|
| 15张牌 | 40秒 |
| 10张牌 | 25秒 |
| 5张牌 | 10秒 |
| 1张牌 | 无 |

contents.en: A player’s opponents’ match-win percentage is the average match-win percentage of each opponent that player faced, ignoring rounds for which the player received a bye.
contents.zh: 牌手的对手局胜率为该牌手所较量过的对手之局胜率的平均值，不计该牌手获得轮空的轮数。

contents.en:
```text
Opponents’ match-win percentage
  = sum of opponents’ match-win percentages
    / number of opponents
```
contents.zh:
```text
对手局胜率
  = 所有对手局胜率之和
    / 对手数量
```
